review_cost.rationale: I'd approve after one round of nits: drop the redundant deps, extract the header/footer used by app.vue and error.vue, centralise the 404 title, and cap/evict the cache. Nothing needs structural rework.

findings.issue: Two useHead title registrations are active on a 404 (page registers data?.label ?? '', NotFound.vue:3 registers 'Not found'); correct output depends on unhead registration order
findings.suggestion: Let the page register its title only in the success branch (or have the 404 branch register the title), so title ownership is unambiguous

findings.issue: In-memory cache Map never evicts expired entries and has no size cap; with data described as 'live', stale entries linger and the map grows with every distinct URL
findings.suggestion: Delete expired entries on read (or sweep on insert) and consider a max-size bound

findings.issue: Upstream fetch has no timeout or AbortSignal, so a hung PokeAPI request hangs the Nitro route indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Pass AbortSignal.timeout(...) (or a runtime-config-driven timeout) to fetch

findings.issue: Header/footer markup is duplicated from app.vue (with raw <a> links) rather than shared components
findings.suggestion: Extract AppHeader/AppFooter components and reuse them; consider clearError + navigateTo for the recovery link

findings.issue: An out-of-range ?page is clamped for display but the URL keeps the invalid value, so 'Page n of total' and the query disagree
findings.suggestion: router.replace the clamped page when it differs from the URL value

findings.issue: vue and vue-router are listed as direct dependencies even though Nuxt manages them; the pinned ranges must now be kept in sync with Nuxt's own
findings.suggestion: Remove them and rely on Nuxt's resolution, or drop the explicit pins

findings.issue: API payload shapes are any (detail, species, pokemon), pushing type-safety entirely onto the hand-maintained shared contracts
findings.suggestion: Define minimal response interfaces for the fields consumed (as STAT_LABELS-style local interfaces) so a rename upstream fails at compile time

findings.issue: All component styles live in one 520-line global stylesheet, far from the components they style, with selectors like .card__sprite
findings.suggestion: Move component-specific blocks into scoped <style> in PokemonCard.vue, MovesTable.vue, etc., keeping only the base/layout layer global

summary: This is a genuinely idiomatic Nuxt 4 app — server routes proxy the API with typed shared contracts, pages use useFetch/useHead/useId the way the docs show, and the Nuxt 4 directory layout is exactly right. The risks I found are all minor: an unevicted cache, no fetch timeout, order-dependent 404 title ownership, and a couple of redundancy/duplication nits. I'd merge after one small round of changes.
